markdown.headingText: Course Portal: CIE IGCSE Science - Chemistry Component
markdown.markdown:
::: {.callout-note} Welcome, students! This specialized section contains study notes, targeted practice question banks (MCQ, Theory, and Alternative to Practical), and past exam papers for the Chemistry components of the **Cambridge IGCSE Combined Science (0653)** and **Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences (Double Award) (0654)** qualifications. ::: ## 1. Course Introduction

The Chemistry component of Cambridge IGCSE Combined Science (0653) and Co-ordinated Sciences (0654) covers fundamental principles of chemistry and chemical reactions, preparing students to appreciate the technological and scientific world around them.

  • Combined Science (0653): A single-award syllabus containing an equal mix of Biology, Chemistry, and Physics. It counts as a single IGCSE grade.
  • Co-ordinated Sciences (0654): A double-award syllabus featuring a more detailed, double-weighted coverage of Biology, Chemistry, and Physics. It counts as two IGCSE grades.
### Assessment Outline (Chemistry Components)

Candidates who have studied the Core syllabus content are entered for Paper 1 (Multiple Choice), Paper 3 (Theory) and either Paper 5 or Paper 6. Candidates who have studied the Extended syllabus content (Core + Supplement) are entered for Paper 2 (Multiple Choice), Paper 4 (Theory) and either Paper 5 or Paper 6.

Assessment Paper Target Curriculum Format & Duration Marks Syllabus Weighting
Paper 1 (Multiple Choice) Core 40 multiple-choice questions — 45 minutes 40 marks 30%
Paper 2 (Multiple Choice) Extended 40 multiple-choice questions — 45 minutes 40 marks 30%
Paper 3 (Theory) Core Short-answer and structured questions — 75 minutes 80 marks 50%
Paper 4 (Theory) Extended Short-answer and structured questions — 75 minutes 80 marks 50%
Paper 5 (Practical Test) Core & Extended Laboratory-based practical tasks — 75 minutes 40 marks 20%
Paper 6 (Alternative to Practical) Core & Extended Written questions on experimental skills — 60 minutes 40 marks 20%
### Syllabus Structure

The Chemistry component comprises 12 major topic areas:

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 1: States of Matter Solids, liquids and gases; physical states; diffusion. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 2: Atoms, Elements & Compounds Elements, compounds and mixtures; atomic structure; the Periodic Table; isotopes; ionic, covalent, and metallic bonding; giant structures. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 3: Stoichiometry Chemical formulae; equations; relative atomic mass; the mole and the Avogadro constant. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 4: Electrochemistry Electrolysis of molten compounds and aqueous solutions; electroplating; fuel cells. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 5: Chemical Energetics Exothermic and endothermic reactions; energy level diagrams. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 6: Chemical Reactions Physical and chemical changes; rates of reaction; reversible reactions and equilibria; redox processes. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 7: Acids, Bases & Salts Acids, bases, pH; neutralisation; salt preparation; identification of ions and gases. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 8: The Periodic Table Periodic trends; Group I, VII, and VIII properties; transition elements. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 9: Metals Properties, alloys; reactivity series; extraction and corrosion of metals. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 10: Chemistry of the Environment Water chemical analysis; fertilisers; greenhouse gases and air quality. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 11: Organic Chemistry Naming, formulae; alkanes, alkenes; alcohols; polymers. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 12: Experimental Techniques Apparatus; separation and purification techniques; paper chromatography. ::: ::: {.download-box} ### Official Academic Resources *Download official CIE Science syllabuses and guides:*
Combined Science (0653) Syllabus (2025-2027) Co-ordinated Sciences (0654) Syllabus (2025-2027)
